definition: An attack that goes over obstacles.
Area of Effect. An attack, ability, or spell that can affect multiple targets.
A health bar that stacks on top of your current health and fortitude that sometimes has unique affects.
A special area to ascend to the next floor.
The affected unit is stunned if they attempt to sprint or dodge.
The affected unit has its vision dramatically reduced.
The ability to transfer damage to an item.
A creation with its own set of abilities and statistics that lasts for a short time before disappearing.
An attack or ability that fires a set number of rounds each time it is used.
Holding down the attack button grants a unique ability. This action causes the caster to stop taking other actions while channeling. Interruptible.
Holding down the attack button grants a unique ability.
An area of effect attack where the damage or effect spreads out from a single point, widening as it extends outwards.
An attack or ability that can be fired continuously by holding down a button.
Ability Cooldowns are reduced and can be used more often.
Damage Type. Ignores the damage reduction that Fortitude provides.
The affected unit has its damage amplified. Capped at +100% increase. Multiple sources of Damage increase stack additively.
The affected unit takes less damage when attacked. Capped at 80% mitigation. Multiple sources of Damage Mitigation stack additively.
Damage Type. Damage is dealt over a period of time rather than instantly.
Damage dealt to the affected unit is returned back to the attacker. This includes damage type such as Piercing or Crushing.
Invulnerable enemies that roam around their spawn point, chases and locks onto players who are within their view.
The affected is pushed or pulled in a unique direction determined by the caster.
An attack or ability that sticks to targets or the environment.

A state that is gained through damaging, blocking or eliminating enemy players as well as healing with abilities (but not consumables or healing anchors); a comeback mechanic. While Empowered gain: +30% Damage Increase and +30% Damage Mitigation. Points needed to be empowered: 400 / 300 / 200 (2 / 1 / 0 teammates alive). Max points while empowered: 500 / 400 / 300 (2 / 1 / 0 teammates alive). +1 per 1 damage, +0.5 per 1 heal (heal abilities only), +0.5 per block, +75 per revival. Minor Eliminations give you % x 1 points (20% x 1 = 20 points). Major Eliminations give you % x 2.5 points (80% x 2.5 = 200 points). Eliminations are based off of individual, not team or other players involved. 12 points decay per second.
Health or HP. A player has a max of 200 health split into segments of 25.
The affected unit is temporarily unable to use its Endurance to Dodge.
An ability or attack that damages multiple enemies in a radius around the initial target.

The blue bar on top of the health bar. A player has 100 Fortitude split into segments of 25. Non-piercing damage is dealt to Fortitude before health. Non-crushing damage can deal a max of 25 damage at a time to fortitude. Fortitude "gates" damage at each breakpoint of 25 fortitude. Example: A player is at 80 fortitude and is hit with a 20 damage (non-crushing) attack. That player only takes 5 damage as the "gate" at 75 fortitude prevents them from taking more.
The affected unit is grappled and is unable to move or take actions until released.
Regain Health and/or Fortitude.
This attack or ability will seek out the closest eligible target.
The affected unit is not visible to the enemy but remains visible to party members. Attacking exits this state.
The affected unit is immune to damage.
The attack or ability pushes the target away from the attacker.
Damage Type. Grants healing based on a percentage of damage dealt.
Awarded to the player who dealt the highest percentage of damage to a target.
Awarded to any player who dealt damage to a target but did not have the highest percentage share.
The affected unit has its movement speed increased.
The affected unit ignores the effect of crushing attacks and takes damage as normal.
The affected unit ignores the effect of piercing attacks and takes damage as normal.
An attack or ability that hits every target in its path.
The affected unit cannot attack, heal, take damage, or be targeted.
Damage Type. Bypasses Fortitude and damages Health.
Outdated, see Damage Return.
The minor NPC enemies that drop Fragments and sometimes Echo items upon death.
Refresh the cooldown of an ability.
Refresh the cooldown of this ability when you knock down an opponent.
Outdated, see Damage Mitigation.
The affected unit is unable to move. A rooted unit can attack and use abilities.
A building to buy items from (may also be known as Shop / Collector).
This ability is cast on a single target, ally, or enemy.
An attack or ability that fires once each time it is used.
The affected unit has its movement speed reduced.
Outdated, see Homing.
The affected unit is immune to slows, stuns, roots, and displacement.
The affected unit is not visible to distant enemies but remains visible to party members and nearby enemies. Attacking exits this state.
The affected unit is unable to move or take actions.
A non-player that fights like an ally for a short time. A summon has its own abilities, statistics, and health pool.
A type of movement that instantly moves the caster from one point to another.

The affected unit is bound to a location with a limited movement radius. The unit can strain against the Tether to break it via movement or dodges. Teleports and unique movement abilities break it instantly.
The map where the Ascension game mode takes place. Divided into three floors.
The affected unit is hurled in a specific direction.
The major NPC enemies that drop Eternal Items upon death. These enemies are the targets of quests. Variants of Tormentors include: Reaver (axe), Scorcher (fire ball), Oracle (laser beam).
Outdated, see Homing.
An attack that burrows under obstacles.
The affected unit take additional damage when attacked.
The affected unit deals less damage when they attack.
